$comment: Dark-theme overrides for the offline topo style. This is a PATCH, not a style: each key is a layer id in topo-style.json and each value is merged over that layer's paint block by buildTopoStyle() in mobile/src/services/tile-service.ts, AFTER the night palette (mobile/src/services/night-style.ts) has repainted every layer of the template the same way it repaints the online Liberty style. So only layers the generic repaint does not suit belong here: the contours, whose warm tan ink is hand-tuned to match the online contour layers (CONTOUR_INK in online-style-service.ts) and lifts in value and opacity because brown on a dark ground loses the contrast brown on cream gets for free. Structure (sources, filters, zooms, layer order) is never duplicated here, and a test asserts every id below still exists in the template.
